title: APV 用例评审

inputs.batch: path of a compiled batch folder (out/) with cases/*.json and machine_mindmap.json
inputs.versionLine: the product version line, such as 10.5
inputs.build: the build the batch was written for; required — review is always against the bound build
inputs.contract: path of the Excel function contract copy the user registered with the hub (schema ist.excel.function-contract)
inputs.checks: hub-saved buildsite.command_check returns or compile-skill checks/<autoid>.json pointers; one per --check, several allowed

model: any capable model; structure, command and contract checks are scripts; coverage, verifiability and risk are model judgement
